<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Jordan 2026-09-02: agents write `pij-rs send --from <self> --to <peer> --msg-id "$(uuidgen)" --body '…'` on every call — wasteful, and the only rs send form takes the body as a literal shell argument. Also (antelope): `export PIJ_SESSION_ID` is a no-op for Claude/Copilot/Codex seats (fresh shell per command), so `pij-rs inbox` fails with no seat after a successful adopt; and the rs pointer text says `run: pij inbox` which is the unrouted bare legacy verb. Rows: req-0041 (+ req-0032 silent usage on missing --msg-id, req-0039(e) body-file as a legacy-shutdown precondition). The shimmed `pij send <id> <text>` already derives sender by pane and mints the id (crates/daemon/src/http/shim.rs, identity::resolve_seat) — the raw CLI must reach parity.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- G1 Identity: every pij-rs verb that needs the acting seat resolves it as PIJ_SESSION_ID → else the pane ($TMUX_PANE against /v1/seats) → else a named refusal that says which env/flag to supply. A supplied --from/--seat that DISAGREES with the pane owner is refused by name (never silently honoured).
- G2 send: --from optional (derived), --msg-id optional (minted as a UUIDv7/ULID by the CLI, echoed in the receipt), --body OR --body-file <path> OR --body-file - (stdin); missing all three = refusal naming the options; a body that starts with `-` is never parsed as a flag.
- G3 Misuse is loud: any missing required input prints a one-line refusal and exits non-zero; usage text is never printed on a failed send (req-0032).
- G4 Pointer/notice text: the daemon's `message waiting` line says `pij inbox check` (routed) not bare `pij inbox`; adopt output for claude/copilot/codex stops instructing `export PIJ_SESSION_ID` and says the pane resolves identity.
- G5 Help shows the short form first: `pij-rs send --to <id> --body '…'` and `pij-rs send --to <id> --body-file -`.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No change to the shim (`pij send`) semantics.
- No pane-typing/delivery changes (s122).
- No new verbs.
